name: Adana
why: Seattle Met 2020-05-22: Shota Nakajima makes Capitol Hill restaurant Adana's closure permanent. Capitol Hill; Adana was the 2017 rebrand of Naka. Own domain returns 404. Address not in source.
jbf_honors: 2018 Semifinalist - Rising Star Chef of the Year (Shota Nakajima)
2019 Semifinalist - Rising Star Chef of the Year (Shota Nakajima)
2020 Semifinalist - Rising Star Chef of the Year (Shota Nakajima)

name: Art of the Table
why: Wallyhood 2024-10-14: Dustin Ronspies closing after 17 years; final regular service Nov 22 (2024). Wallingford. Seattle Met also has a 2024-10 closing story (seattlemet.com/eat-and-drink/2024/10/art-of-the-table-closing, not fetched). Own domain returns 404.

name: Bar Sajor
why: Seattle Met 2016-07-12: Matt Dillon's Bar Sajor 'served its last meal Saturday night'. Pioneer Square. Space reportedly reopened as Copal (per Wikipedia citing Food & Wine; not verified). Address not given in source.

name: Bateau
why: Seattle Met 2026-02-13: Bateau and Boat Bar (temporarily closed June 2025) merge into a new steakhouse, Jeffry's, reopening March 11, 2026. RENAMED: Bateau no longer exists under that name. Successor Jeffry's own site (jeffrysseattle.com) is live: 1060 E Union St, Seattle 98122, Wed-Sun 5-9pm (photos dated 2026-03). Bateau's old address per Wikipedia was 1040 E Union St (unverified). Own site restaurantbateau.com returned 403.

name: Copine
why: Seattle Met 2025-12-12: Copine to keep serving through May 30 (2026) then close; own site copineseattle.com now refers to 'its 10 years in operation' in past tense and offers only 'Copine Project' consulting/private chef services. Closed ~May 30, 2026. Ballard. Address not in fetched sources (Wikipedia lists 6460 24th Ave NW, 98107 - unverified).

name: Eden Hill
why: Seattle Met 2025-09-12 calls Eden Hill 'now-closed'; Seattle Met 2025-04-11 said it would stay open until September 2025 after a decade; MyNorthwest 2025-09-26 lists it as closed. Queen Anne. edenhillrestaurant.com now redirects to an unrelated gambling site. Address not in sources (believed 2209 Queen Anne Ave N - unverified).
jbf_honors: 2016 Semifinalist - Rising Star Chef of the Year (Maximillian Petty)
2017 Semifinalist - Rising Star Chef of the Year (Maximillian Petty)
2018 Semifinalist - Rising Star Chef of the Year (Maximillian Petty)

name: Eight Row
why: Seattle Met: Eight Row closing; final dinner service June 29, 2024 (lease up); owners hope to reopen somewhere eventually, no timeline. Also in Seattle Met's 2024 closures roundup (2024-12-20). eightrow.com now 301-redirects to a design agency portfolio page. Street address is the last-known address from the Overture listing, not from the article. The family is planning a separate restaurant in Wenatchee.
jbf_honors: 2022 Semifinalist - Best Chef: Northwest and Pacific (David Nichols)
2023 Semifinalist - Best Chef: Northwest and Pacific (David Nichols)
2024 Semifinalist - Outstanding Wine and Other Beverages Program

name: Il Corvo
why: Seattle Met 2020-05-06: Mike Easton announces Il Corvo will not reopen after COVID shutdown; Seattle Met 2023-01-30 confirms it never reopened. Pioneer Square. Easton now runs Bar Bacetto in Waitsburg, WA. ilcorvopasta.com now redirects to an unrelated site. Address not in sources.
jbf_honors: 2016 Finalist - Best Chef: Northwest (Mike Easton) [as 'Il Corvo Pasta']

name: JuneBaby
why: MyNorthwest 2023-12-21: Edouardo Jordan closing JuneBaby; last day Dec 31, 2023. Ravenna. junebabyseattle.com is now an unrelated casino-review site. Address not in source (Wikipedia: 2122 NE 65th St, 98115 - unverified).

name: Mamnoon
why: Seattle Met 2025-08-25: Mamnoon to close Sept 14, 2025 after 13 years; own site mamnoonrestaurant.com/mamnoon: 'Sunday September 14th 2025 was mamnoon's last service.'. Brand continues only as Mamnoon Fine Foods retail/catering. Seattle Met 2025-12-19 roundup also lists Mamnooncita, Hanoon, Mamnoon Street and mBar among 2025 closures.

name: No Anchor
why: Seattle Met 2021-12-28 year-end closures: No Anchor pivoted in July 2021 into a neighborhood tavern; caption 'No Anchor is now Trade Winds Tavern'. RENAMED: became Trade Winds Tavern (same owners Chris Elford & Anu Apte). Trade Winds' current status not checked. Own site has a broken (Squarespace) cert. Address not in source.

name: Opus Co.
why: Seattle Met 2021-07-20: Opus Co. closing, operating through early September 2021; space going to The Chicken Supply; Seattle Met 2021-12-28 says it served its final tasting menu in September. Phinney Ridge. Own domain no longer resolves.

name: Poppy
why: Seattle Met 2019-07-15: Jerry Traunfeld to close Poppy after dinner Sun Aug 4 (2019); Altura owners to open Carrello in the space. Address = Carrello's address per Carrello's own site (Carrello occupies the former Poppy space per Seattle Met). poppyseattle.com no longer resolves.

name: Salare
why: Seattle Met 2021-06-08: Edouardo Jordan will close Salare permanently July 3 (2021); Seattle Met 2021-12-28 confirms it shut July 3. Ravenna. salarerestaurant.com is now an unrelated gambling site. Address not in source.

name: Sitka & Spruce
why: Seattle Met 2019-09-25: Matt Dillon closing Sitka & Spruce (Melrose Market) after New Year's Eve 2019. Own domain has an expired cert. Address not in source (was in Melrose Market, Capitol Hill).

name: Sophon
why: The Stranger: 'Sophon Appears to Be Shuttered', closed after staff walkout and unpaid taxes, business license revoked early June 2026; KIRO 7 2026-06-18 also reports it shuttered. LOCATION MISMATCH: Sophon was in Phinney Ridge (7314 Greenwood Ave N per Seattle Met 2024-06-11), not Columbia City. Closed June 2026. KIRO 7: https://www.kiro7.com/news/local/james-beard-nominated-phinney-ridge-restaurant-shutters-after-amassing-160k-debt/BJCIZS4Q6RB5XKKLQLZEOEYFPQ/

name: Stateside
why: MyNorthwest story: Stateside (Eric Johnson's Vietnamese-French restaurant) closed suddenly, lease expired; also in Seattle Met's 2025 closures roundup (2025-12-19). Sister bar Foreign National also closed. Own site statesideseattle.com now shows 'Squarespace - Website Expired'. Street address is the last-known address from the Overture listing, not from the closure story.

name: The Whale Wins
why: Seattle Met 2025-07-11: Whale Wins to close when its lease runs out at end of October 2025; own site thewhalewins.com now says 'The Whale Wins is permanently closed... thirteen amazing years'. Closed end of Oct 2025 (Renee Erickson / Sea Creatures). Address from own site. Listed among 2025 closures in Seattle Met 2025-12-19 roundup.

name: Upper Bar Ferdinand
why: Seattle Met 2020-05-11: the former Bar Ferdinand space in Chophouse Row will become wine bar Light Sleeper. Upper Bar Ferdinand was later called just 'Bar Ferdinand' (Matt Dillon, Chophouse Row, Capitol Hill); Seattle Met 2017-12-28 noted the Melrose Market Lower Bar Ferdinand folded into it. Chophouse Row's own tenant list (copyright 2026) no longer includes it. Address not in source.

name: Fast Eddy's
why: Union-Bulletin: drive-in 'serving customers for a quarter century'; building sold, 'last day in business will be Thursday, Oct. 1' (2026). Only ~25 years old, so not an oldest-list candidate.
